text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Mornin'! Kita-chan, you there~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I made a good luck charm for 
winning the Kikuka Sho. Here, Kita-chan—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm sorry. It looks like Kita-chan 
headed up into the mountains for training 
again today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Mountain seclusion training?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san! Reach the summit in the 
remaining 30 minutes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: “—Whoa, careful!! ...W-Wahhh...”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kita-san!? Are you okay!? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I-I'm fine. I don't feel pain anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ……! But still.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't force yourself to endure it. 
This special training is originally meant 
for the Tenno Sho (Spring), after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I'm completely fine! Besides, both the 
Tenno Sho (Spring) and the Kikuka Sho are 
long-distance races, aren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So――I have to be able to handle at least 
this much! Being sturdy is my only 
redeeming quality, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Just to be safe, I had the medical 
staff check her over as well. They 
reported that Kita-san's body has "no 
abnormalities."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Kita-san's body really is 
tough, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just as the preliminary tests showed. 
She can endure this training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"After telling us, 'I want to ask for your 
guidance,' she sprinted up the slope 
course three times right before our eyes."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As far as I am aware— in the current 
Umamusume training environment, only a 
limited number of girls have accomplished 
that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Not yet!! Still not neaaarly enooough!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume pass in front of the 
grandstand. Who will claim the title of 
the strongest Umamusume in the Kikuka 
Sho?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's watch the final jewel of the crown 
in person." With that, I had visited Kyoto 
Racecourse with Satono Crown, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Kitasan is in 6th place. She's holding 
back more than usual, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... isn't Kitasan Black barely keeping 
up? Her stamina ran out in the Derby too, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Forget that! I really wanted Duramente to 
win that final crown...! Ughhh...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, passing the halfway mark between the 
3rd and 4th corners! The Umamusume charge 
down the slope—and into the final 
straight! They are heading into the final 
stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haah—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—I don't have the weapons or flashy flair 
that Duramente-san or Kura-chan have.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm such a weak Umamusume for thinking 
that maybe I could win the Kikuka Sho just 
because Duramente-san wouldn't be running 
in it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Still, though!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black from the innermost rail! 
Kitasan Black thrusts forward from the 
inside rail!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Wha—! Kitasan!? Don't tell me it's 
you—...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome... Look at you go! ...Go! 
Gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Kitasan Black! Conquering 
the stage of the Chrysanthemum is Kitasan 
Black!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much!! Thank you for 
cheering me on!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —This is it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Just gotta keep this up...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The more I push myself, the harder I work, 
âthe more dreams I'm trusted to carry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The surrounding spectators shower the 
winner with cheers. Amidst it all, Satono 
Crown—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...It has finally blossomed, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sinister glint flashed deep within her 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Kikuka-sho. Satono Crown 
and I spent this day organizing 
information together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“A dramatic victory for Kitasan Black. Her 
next race: the grand racing festival, the 
Arima Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Could I get her data for the 
Satsuki Sho and the Derby once more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the laptop in front of me, I send 
Kitasan Black's data to Satono Crown's 
address.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the Satsuki Sho and Derby 
trends, I was sure she'd run in first or 
second position, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Should we run as a leader from now on? Or 
will we try leading all the way from the 
front next time? Ah... we also need to 
re-evaluate her best distance itself—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...There. The analysis is in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The Satono medical and AI teams 
have joined forces to develop an app. It 
assesses an Umamusume's growth period 
through skeletal analysis—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Huh? Is this really the 
conclusion we've come to~?
choice_data_list: So, what did the analysis show?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is in the middle of a growth 
spurt—"She won't reach her peak until next 
spring or later."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"She's like a butterfly that has only just 
emerged from its cocoon. Her wings are 
still unstable. By tomorrow, she will 
surely evolve even further."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, even if we prepare for 
how Kitasan is now, there's no telling if 
we can beat tomorrow's Kitasan."
choice_data_list: ...! There's no way to counter it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: She's extraordinary, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even her performance at the Kikuka Sho, 
which decides the strongest Umamusume, was 
still incomplete, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Ufufu! Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think, Trainer? Another 
monster of the generation has been born."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... The Twinkle Series sure is 
interesting.
